# Store regnskaber sætter dagsordenen

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-11-05  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a Danish Millionærklubben episode (EuroInvestor) about a busy day of Danish Q3 reports, recorded just after a US midterm election the Democrats won. Hyperscalers rallied on expected limits to new data centres, while chip and AI-infrastructure names fell. The panel tone is cautious and risk-off: Ørsted is criticised as structurally risky, and Maersk fell 10% despite raising guidance, which split the panel. Novonesis and Ambu reported well, and GN Store Nord's sale of its hearing business raises concern about how the cash will be redeployed.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ ORSTED — Ørsted | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Carsten would never invest; Joachim sees an existential crisis.

#### Reasoning

Guest Carsten: 4-5% ROE yet trades above book; a risky developer model; more impairments expected in Q4 from rising rates; 9M cash flow -12.5bn. Host Joachim: no project wins in years, development pipeline nearly empty. Capex cut reflects lower activity. Only positive: guidance maintained.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the company starts winning new offshore projects
- if rates fall sharply, removing impairment pressure

> *"Det er en af de aktier, som jeg ærligt aldrig ville investere i."*

---

### 🟠 MAERSK-B — A.P. Møller-Mærsk | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Lars sees the 10% drop as an overreaction (fair value 25,000, NAV ~27,000) but prefers Torm; Carsten finds it expensive on 2028 earnings.

#### Reasoning

Guest Lars Svendsen calls the drop exaggerated and the stock a 'discount' versus equity. He is considering buying, and buybacks support it. Carsten: the guidance raise is still below consensus, earnings are not normalised, ~6x 2026 but >60x 2028 P/E, and a Red Sea reopening could add ~10% capacity and crush rates. He would not hold it as a long-term investor.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Red Sea/Suez route reopens and freight rates collapse
- if port congestion eases
- if 2027-28 earnings fall as feared

> *"jeg synes, at Epimøller bliver dæmt"*

---

### 🟢 TRMD-A — Torm | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lars Svendsen would pick Torm over Maersk today, after a fine report and a share price dip.

#### Reasoning

Guest Lars Svendsen: tankers have pulled back for several days despite good results. Asked by a listener, he says he would choose Torm, and he speculates about a takeover offer at 280-300. Short-term, opportunistic view.

#### Sell Triggers

- if tanker rates weaken
- if the expected offer does not materialise

> *"så hvis jeg skulle vælge i dag, så vil jeg altså nok tage selvom jeg er hund af bemødder så vil jeg tage Torm"*

---

### 🟡 NSIS-B — Novonesis | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Carsten owns it long term: quality company, organic growth beat, strong Q4 outlook, but P/E 45.

#### Reasoning

Guest Carsten calls it a high-quality company: 7% organic growth vs 6% expected, margin >38%, and 10-15% growth in Food & Beverage and Household Care with a strong global position. He says the premium multiple is deserved. Risks: P/E 45, slow merger synergies, weaker human health.

#### Sell Triggers

- if merger synergies keep disappointing
- if growth in Food & Beverage/Household Care slows
- if human health weakens further

> *"Det her er et rigtig godt kvalitetsselskab, vi taler om her."*

---

### 🟠 GN — GN Store Nord | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Sum-of-parts value 140-150 per Carsten, but he fears management will waste the hearing-sale proceeds on bad M&A.

#### Reasoning

Guest Carsten: 20 years of value destruction through M&A. The 17bn hearing sale goes to 9bn debt repayment and ~4bn buybacks, which leaves ~4bn to invest, and that worries him. Valuation looks attractive, but management is the risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- if management announces new value-destructive acquisitions
- if the hearing sale fails to close
- if Amplifon shares fall further

> *"Så det, de er ude i nu endnu en gang, det er at smide gode penge efter dårlige."*

---

### 🟢 ORCL — Oracle | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Joachim sees a comeback case: big data-centre capacity now shielded from competition.

#### Reasoning

Host Joachim: the Democratic midterm win makes data-centre permits harder, so existing compute becomes scarcer and more valuable. Oracle invested massively in capacity; its debt is the issue, but it is an interesting comeback if rates stay under control.

#### Sell Triggers

- if interest rates keep rising
- if Oracle's debt problems worsen

> *"så tror jeg, at det er en af de comeback-cases, der kunne være ret interessante"*

---

### ⛔ QCOM — Qualcomm | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Revenue falling and smartphone business hurt; Joachim is worried if rates stay high.

#### Reasoning

Host Joachim: the core smartphone chip business suffers as chips go to data centres and phone prices rise. Auto chips are growing but small, and the data-centre push does not move the needle yet.

#### Sell Triggers

- if rates fall
- if data-centre/auto revenues scale meaningfully

> *"Så Qualcomm er en af de der AI-aktier, som jeg godt kunne være en lille smule bekymret omkring"*

---

### 🟢 NVDA — Nvidia | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Joachim still sees a good long-term case for chip stocks; Pluto users bought Nvidia on the dip.

#### Reasoning

Host Joachim: chip shortages persist and post-election moves usually revert within weeks, so the long-term case in chip stocks holds despite the midterm sell-off.

#### Sell Triggers

- if data-centre buildout is materially curtailed
- if chip shortages end

> *"Så jeg tror altså stadig, der er en rimelig god langsigtet case i at investere ind i cheap aktier."*

---
